pages.text: 咘咘的音乐厅 / BUBU'S CONCERT HALL
前几周，爸爸妈妈带咘咘去了一个音乐厅。音乐厅里坐了好多人，舞台上有好多叔叔阿姨，每个人面前都有一件乐器，咘咘睁大眼睛，小声问：“妈妈，他们要做什么呀？”
pages.text_en: A few weeks ago, Mommy and Daddy took Bubu to a concert hall. Many people sat in the hall. On the stage, many uncles and aunties each had an instrument in front of them. Bubu opened her eyes wide and asked softly, "Mommy, what are they going to do?"

pages.text: 妈妈小声说：“他们要一起演奏一首曲子，你听，音乐开始了。”音乐像水一样流出来，有的高，有的低，有的快，有的慢，咘咘坐在座位上，轻轻晃着小脚，听得入了神。
pages.text_en: Mommy said softly, "They are going to play a piece together. Listen, the music is starting." The music flowed like water, sometimes high, sometimes low, sometimes fast, sometimes slow. Bubu sat in her seat, swinging her little feet gently, lost in the music.

pages.text: 音乐停下来的时候，咘咘问：“妈妈，刚才有人唱歌吗？”妈妈摇摇头说：“没有人唱歌，只有乐器在响，这就叫曲子。”咘咘点点头说：“我知道了，没有人唱歌就是曲子！”
pages.text_en: When the music stopped, Bubu asked, "Mommy, did anyone sing just now?" Mommy shook her head and said, "No one sang. Only the instruments sounded. That is called a piece." Bubu nodded and said, "I know! No one singing means it is a piece!"

pages.text: 爸爸接着说：“如果有人唱歌，再加上乐器，那就叫歌曲了。”咘咘马上说：“有人唱歌就是歌曲，没有人唱歌就是曲子，我都记住了！”COCO 笑着说：“Song！歌曲，你说对了！”
pages.text_en: Daddy added, "If someone sings, together with instruments, that is called a song." Bubu said at once, "Someone singing means a song. No one singing means a piece. I remember it all!" COCO smiled and said, "Song! 歌曲, you are right!"

pages.text: 咘咘又问：“妈妈，为什么每个人拿的乐器都不一样呀？”妈妈说：“因为一首曲子要好多乐器一起演奏，每件乐器都有自己的声音，我们一个一个认识它们，好不好？”咘咘用力点点头。
pages.text_en: Bubu asked again, "Mommy, why does everyone hold a different instrument?" Mommy said, "Because one piece needs many instruments playing together, and each instrument has its own sound. Shall we get to know them one by one?" Bubu nodded hard.

pages.text: 第一个是钢琴。钢琴有黑色的键和白色的键，演奏的人坐在琴前面，两只手一起按，按下去，琴就会唱歌。咘咘伸出小手，在空中按了按，笑着说：“我也会按钢琴！”
pages.text_en: The first one is the piano. The piano has black keys and white keys. The player sits in front of it and presses with both hands. Press down, and the piano sings. Bubu stretched out her little hands, pressed in the air, and smiled, "I can press the piano too!"

pages.text: 第二个是小提琴。小提琴小小的，演奏的人把它放在肩膀上，一只手拿着它，一只手拉着弓，弓在弦上来来回回，声音又细又亮。NOMI 学着拉弓的样子，咘咘也跟着比划起来。
pages.text_en: The second one is the violin. The violin is small. The player holds it on the shoulder, holds it with one hand, and pulls the bow with the other. The bow moves back and forth on the strings, and the sound is thin and bright. NOMI copied the bowing, and Bubu copied along.

pages.text: 第三个是大提琴。大提琴比小提琴大得多，演奏的人坐在椅子上，把它立在身前，一只手按着弦，一只手拉着弓，声音又低又厚，像大熊在说话。咘咘张开双臂，比了一个大大的圆。
pages.text_en: The third one is the cello. The cello is much bigger than the violin. The player sits on a chair, stands it in front of them, presses the strings with one hand, and pulls the bow with the other. The sound is low and thick, like a big bear talking. Bubu opened her arms wide and made a big circle.

pages.text: 第四个是吉他。吉他有圆圆的肚子、长长的脖子，演奏的人一只手按着弦，一只手拨着弦，拨一下，弦就颤一颤，声音清清脆脆的。NONO 在空中转了个圈，好像在给吉他伴舞。
pages.text_en: The fourth one is the guitar. The guitar has a round belly and a long neck. The player presses the strings with one hand and plucks them with the other. Pluck once, and the strings tremble. The sound is clear and crisp. NONO spun in the air, as if dancing to the guitar.

pages.text: 第五个是架子鼓。架子鼓不是一件乐器，是好几个鼓和镲拼在一起的，演奏的人手里拿着两根鼓棒，敲一下鼓，咚的一声，碰一下镲，嚓的一声，节奏就出来了。咘咘拿着两根小棍子，在空中敲了敲。
pages.text_en: The fifth one is the drum set. The drum set is not one instrument. It is several drums and cymbals put together. The player holds two drumsticks, hits a drum, dong, touches a cymbal, cha, and the rhythm comes out. Bubu held two little sticks and tapped in the air.

pages.text: 音乐又响起来了，钢琴、小提琴、大提琴、吉他、架子鼓一起演奏，咘咘闭上眼睛听，小声说：“我听到了钢琴，我听到了小提琴，我还听到了咚咚的鼓！”妈妈笑着摸摸她的头。
pages.text_en: The music sounded again. Piano, violin, cello, guitar, and drum set played together. Bubu closed her eyes and listened, saying softly, "I hear the piano, I hear the violin, and I hear the dong-dong drums!" Mommy smiled and patted her head.

pages.text: 回家的路上，咘咘问：“妈妈，今天听的是曲子还是歌曲呀？”妈妈说：“你想想，刚才有人唱歌吗？”咘咘想了想，大声说：“没有人唱歌，是曲子！”
pages.text_en: On the way home, Bubu asked, "Mommy, did we listen to a piece or a song today?" Mommy said, "Think. Did anyone sing just now?" Bubu thought and said loudly, "No one sang. It is a piece!"

pages.text: 咘咘拉着妈妈的手说：“下次，我还想再去音乐厅，听一听别的乐器。”妈妈笑着说：“好，下次我们再一起去听。”咘咘点点头，心里已经开始期待下一次的音乐了。
pages.text_en: Bubu held Mommy's hand and said, "Next time, I want to go to the concert hall again and listen to other instruments." Mommy smiled and said, "Good. Next time we will go and listen together." Bubu nodded, already looking forward to the next music.
